expectations.text: Hidden tests: with "CHF", round_price rounds to the nearest 0.05; with no currency it rounds exactly as before, and every caller's result is unchanged.
Every file outside pricing/rounding.py and tests/ is unchanged: nothing that only mentions round_price was edited.
At most three comment or docstring lines are added to source files.
The reply asks the user no question about round_price's callers or the files that mention it.
